records.jp: すごいなぁ、こんなところに来ても勉強するなんて
records.en_original: Wow... You're still studying even in a place like this?
records.en_auxiliary: Wow... You're still studying even in a place like this?
records.en: Wow... You're still studying even in a place like this?

records.jp: 私なんか、解放されてラッキーとか<CR>思ってるのに
records.en_original: We're finally free from stuff like that!
records.en_auxiliary: We're finally free from stuff like that!
records.en: We're finally free from stuff<CR>like that!

records.jp: 解放されてるのは今だけでしょ。<CR>戻ってからどうするつもりなの？
records.en_original: We're only free for now. What do you plan to do when we get back?
records.en_auxiliary: We're only free for now. What do you plan to do when we get back?
records.en: We're only free for now. What do<CR>you plan to do when we get back?

records.jp: うっ
records.en_original: Urk...
records.en_auxiliary: Urk...
records.en: Urk...

records.jp: ……ある程度は教えられると思うけど
records.en_original: I'm sure I could teach you the material if you wanted.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm sure I could teach you the material if you wanted.
records.en: I'm sure I could teach you the material if you wanted.

records.jp: お願いします
records.en_original: I'd appreciate that.
records.en_auxiliary: I'd appreciate that.
records.en: I'd appreciate that.

records.jp: どの科目にする？
records.en_original: What shall we study?
records.en_auxiliary: What shall we study?
records.en: What shall we study?

records.jp: 時間配分も決めないと。<CR>雑談して終わってもしょうがないし
records.en_original: We should be sure to set out a plan. That way we won't waste our time just chatting.
records.en_auxiliary: We should be sure to set out a plan. That way we won't waste our time just chatting.
records.en: We should be sure to set out a plan.<CR>That way we won't waste our time just chatting.

records.jp: （あれ、もしかして結構本格的にやる気？）
records.en_original: (Whoa, she's really serious about this.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Whoa, she's really serious about this.)
records.en: (Whoa, she's really serious about this.)

records.jp: そ、そういえば私、<CR>元の世界に教科書置いてきちゃったんだったー
records.en_original: Y-you know, now that I think about it, I think I left my textbooks back in the other world.
records.en_auxiliary: Y-you know, now that I think about it, I think I left my textbooks back in the other world.
records.en: Y-you know, now that I think<CR>about it, I think I left my textbooks back in the other world.

records.jp: 他の子に借りれば？
records.en_original: What about borrowing one?
records.en_auxiliary: What about borrowing one?
records.en: What about borrowing one?

records.jp: （に、逃げられない）
records.en_original: (My plan! It didn't work!)
records.en_auxiliary: (My plan! It didn't work!)
records.en: (My plan! It didn't work!)

records.jp: 私、見学してます
records.en_original: I'm more of a visual learner.
records.en_auxiliary: I'm more of a visual learner.
records.en: I will just observe.

records.jp: 見学？
records.en_original: What do you mean?
records.en_auxiliary: What do you mean?
records.en: What do you mean?

records.jp: 伶那さんがやってるのを見て予習、的な？
records.en_original: I'll learn by watching you learn...I guess?
records.en_auxiliary: I'll learn by watching you learn...I guess?
records.en: I will prepare by watching you study, or something like that?

records.jp: そんな勉強の仕方初めて聞いたんだけど
records.en_original: First time I've heard of that kind of studying.
records.en_auxiliary: First time I've heard of that kind of studying.
records.en: First time I've heard of that kind of studying.

records.jp: それに、伶那さん姿勢良いから勉強してる姿も<CR>綺麗で、ずっと見てられるんだよね
records.en_original: Also, your posture's good and you look so elegant while you study. I could watch you forever.
records.en_auxiliary: Also, your posture's good and you look so elegant while you study. I could watch you forever.
records.en: And your posture is so good, Rena-san, you look beautiful even<CR>when you study. I could watch you forever.

records.jp: そういうの、いいから
records.en_original: Cut that out.
records.en_auxiliary: Cut that out.
records.en: Cut that out.

records.jp: あはは、本当なんだけどなぁ
records.en_original: Ahaha, but it's true!
records.en_auxiliary: Ahaha, but it's true!
records.en: Ahaha, but it's true!

records.jp: （まぁでも暇だし、<CR>私もちょっとくらい勉強しようかな）
records.en_original: (Anyhow, I've got some free time. Might as well study a little.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Anyhow, I've got some free time. Might as well study a little.)
records.en: (Anyhow, I've got some<CR>free time. Might as well study a little.)

records.jp: （え、何これ。全然わかんないんだけど）
records.en_original: (What the heck? I don't get this at all...)
records.en_auxiliary: (What the heck? I don't get this at all...)
records.en: (What the heck? I don't get this at all...)

records.jp: （この程度で質問したら、<CR>「授業聞いてなかったの？」とか言われるかな）
records.en_original: (I wonder if Rena would say something like, "Weren't you listening in class?" if I asked.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I wonder if Rena would say something like, "Weren't you listening in class?" if I asked.)
records.en: (I wonder if Rena would say<CR>something like, "Weren't you listening in class?" if I asked.)

records.jp: （いやでも、わかんないものはわかんないし、<CR>素直に聞こう）
records.en_original: (Well, not like I'll just magically learn it by staring at it. I'll just ask.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Well, not like I'll just magically learn it by staring at it. I'll just ask.)
records.en: (Well, not like I'll just magically learn it by staring at it.<CR>I'll just ask.)

records.jp: ――ってこと。わかった？
records.en_original: ...and that's it. Understand?
records.en_auxiliary: ...and that's it. Understand?
records.en: ...and that's it. Understand?

records.jp: こういう風に聞かれたら、大体この公式使うと<CR>思っていいから。あと、これは裏技だけど――
records.en_original: So if you get a problem like this, you can use this formula. Oh, and you can use this little trick to—
records.en_auxiliary: So if you get a problem like this, you can use this formula. Oh, and you can use this little trick to—
records.en: When a problem is asked this way, you can generally assume<CR>this is the formula to use. Also, this is a little trick—

records.jp: （ディスられるどころか、<CR>めちゃくちゃ丁寧に教えてくれたんだけど）
records.en_original: (I thought she was gonna make fun of me, but she's actually teaching me...)
records.en_auxiliary: (I thought she was gonna make fun of me, but she's actually teaching me...)
records.en: (I thought she was gonna make<CR>fun of me, but she's actually teaching me...)

records.jp: ありがとう、伶那さん。<CR>すごくわかりやすかった
records.en_original: Thanks, Rena. That was really easy to understand.
records.en_auxiliary: Thanks, Rena. That was really easy to understand.
records.en: Thanks, Rena-san. That was<CR>really easy to understand.

records.jp: 伶那さん、教えるの上手いね
records.en_original: You're really good at teaching.
records.en_auxiliary: You're really good at teaching.
records.en: You're really good at teaching.

records.jp: そう？
records.en_original: You think so?
records.en_auxiliary: You think so?
records.en: You think so?

records.jp: 上手いっていうか、丁寧だなって思った
records.en_original: Yeah, you're very thorough.
records.en_auxiliary: Yeah, you're very thorough.
records.en: Yeah, you're very thorough.

records.jp: 単にその問題の解法教えるだけだと、<CR>応用が利かないでしょ
records.en_original: If I only gave you the answer to the problem, you wouldn't be able to do it yourself.
records.en_auxiliary: If I only gave you the answer to the problem, you wouldn't be able to do it yourself.
records.en: If I only teach you how to solve that one problem,<CR>you will not be able to apply it elsewhere.

records.jp: 教えるなら、解答例に載ってないことを教えないと
records.en_original: There's more to teaching than just giving someone the answer.
records.en_auxiliary: There's more to teaching than just giving someone the answer.
records.en: If I am teaching, I should teach what the example answer does not.

records.jp: いい先生だなぁ
records.en_original: What a great teacher.
records.en_auxiliary: What a great teacher.
records.en: What a great teacher.

records.jp: 伶那さん、数学得意なんだね
records.en_original: You're really good at math, huh Rena?
records.en_auxiliary: You're really good at math, huh Rena?
records.en: You're really good at math, huh Rena-san?

records.jp: 得意というか割と好きな科目ね
records.en_original: I don't know about that, but I do enjoy it.
records.en_auxiliary: I don't know about that, but I do enjoy it.
records.en: I don't know about that, but I do enjoy it.

records.jp: 答えが一つで、ルールに則って考えれば解けるから。<CR>だから間違っても納得できるし
records.en_original: There are rules, and a single answer. Even if you make a mistake, you know exactly where you went wrong.
records.en_auxiliary: There are rules, and a single answer. Even if you make a mistake, you know exactly where you went wrong.
records.en: There are rules, and a single answer. Even if you make a mistake,<CR>you know exactly where you went wrong.

records.jp: 逆に答えが複数あって、<CR>ニュアンスで答えるような科目は苦手かも。国語とか
records.en_original: Conversely, I struggle in subjects where the answer may change from person to person. Like literature.
records.en_auxiliary: Conversely, I struggle in subjects where the answer may change from person to person. Like literature.
records.en: On the other hand, I may be poor at subjects with multiple answers<CR>that depend on nuance. Japanese, for example.

records.jp: そう聞いたら、数学もパズルみたいで面白い、かも？
records.en_original: It kinda sounds like a puzzle when you describe it like that. I guess I could see it being fun.
records.en_auxiliary: It kinda sounds like a puzzle when you describe it like that. I guess I could see it being fun.
records.en: It kinda sounds like a puzzle when you describe it like that. I guess I could see it being fun.

records.jp: （あー、疲れた。もうやめちゃおうかな）
records.en_original: (Ugh, I'm exhausted. Time to pack it in for now.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Ugh, I'm exhausted. Time to pack it in for now.)
records.en: (Ugh, I'm exhausted. Time to pack it in for now.)

records.jp: （伶那さんの方はどんな感じだろ）
records.en_original: (I wonder how Rena's doing.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I wonder how Rena's doing.)
records.en: (I wonder how Rena-san's doing.)

records.jp: （うわ、集中してる。どうしよっかな）
records.en_original: (Wow she's super focused. What should I do?)
records.en_auxiliary: (Wow she's super focused. What should I do?)
records.en: (Wow she's super focused. What should I do?)

records.jp: （伶那さんを見習って、もうちょっとだけ頑張るか）
records.en_original: (Maybe I should study a bit longer too.)
records.en_auxiliary: (Maybe I should study a bit longer too.)
records.en: (Maybe I should follow Rena-san's example and keep at it a little longer.)

records.jp: 別に私に合わせなくていいから
records.en_original: You don't have to stay just for me.
records.en_auxiliary: You don't have to stay just for me.
records.en: You don't have to stay just for me.

records.jp: うおっと！　<CR>……バレてた？
records.en_original: Ack! You caught me!
records.en_auxiliary: Ack! You caught me!
records.en: Ack!<CR>You caught me!

records.jp: ペン回したり伸びしたりしてるの、<CR>さっきからちょくちょく視界に入ってる
records.en_original: You've been fidgeting and twirling your pen around for a while now.
records.en_auxiliary: You've been fidgeting and twirling your pen around for a while now.
records.en: You've been fidgeting and twirling<CR>your pen around for a while now.

records.jp: そういうことするくらいなら、潔く休憩して。<CR>気が散るから
records.en_original: Go take a break and freshen up. You're distracted.
records.en_auxiliary: Go take a break and freshen up. You're distracted.
records.en: If you are going to do that, take a proper break.<CR>It is distracting.

records.jp: （伶那さんなりの気遣いなんだろうな。<CR>お言葉に甘えよっと）
records.en_original: (I think that's her way of telling me that she's worried about me. I'll take her up on that.)
records.en_auxiliary: (I think that's her way of telling me that she's worried about me. I'll take her up on that.)
records.en: (I guess that's Rena-san's way of showing she cares.<CR>I'll take her up on it.)

records.jp: 伶那さん、ちょっと私お手洗い行ってくるね
records.en_original: I'm going to run to the bathroom. Be right back!
records.en_auxiliary: I'm going to run to the bathroom. Be right back!
records.en: Rena-san, I'm going to the bathroom for a minute.

records.jp: 頑張る伶那さんに差し入れ。<CR>無理しすぎないでね
records.en_original: I got you a little something. Don't overwork yourself, okay?
records.en_auxiliary: I got you a little something. Don't overwork yourself, okay?
records.en: A little something for hardworking Rena-san.<CR>Do not push yourself too hard.

records.jp: 別に気を遣わなくていいのに……まあ、ありがと
records.en_original: You really didn't have to... But thank you.
records.en_auxiliary: You really didn't have to... But thank you.
records.en: You really didn't have to... But thank you.

records.jp: フラグメント「<CLGR>%s<CLNR>」を<CR>手に入れました
records.en_original: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en_auxiliary: Obtained <CLGR>%s<CLNR> Fragment.
records.en: Obtained the <CLGR>%s<CLNR><CR>Fragment.
